site.title: Frontend Design Styles
site.tagline: Pick one by feel. Take it with you.
site.intro: No need to know design movements. Every thumbnail is a real render of that style — if it feels right, open it, download a zip, and take the whole thing.
home.step2: Download the pack, unzip and use
home.step3: Want your own page? Copy it to AI
home.search: Search styles, features or sites — e.g. gradient, radius, apple

01.name: Neo-Brutalism
01.desc: Treats the page as raw, unpolished material: heavy black borders and hard offset shadows that read as honest and rebellious.
01.feat: 3px solid black borders / zero-radius blocky cards / 6px hard shadow, no blur / dot-grid ground / monospaced uppercase labels / EXP.01 numbering

02.name: Swiss Style
02.desc: Born in 1950s Zürich and Basel: replace every ornament with a grid and a type hierarchy.
02.feat: 12-column grid / asymmetric 4+8 layout / 900-weight sans headings / ink, grey, paper, hairline / catalogue numbering / no radius anywhere

03.name: Japanese Editorial
03.desc: Brings magazine layout to the web: warm paper ground, hairline rules, a single fluorescent accent.
03.feat: #f1f0ea paper ground / low-contrast warm-grey rules / CJK setting with tabular numerals / fluorescent yellow underline / oversized margins / low-saturation warm palette

04.name: Terminal CLI Aesthetic
04.desc: Puts the command line in the browser: monospace type and status LEDs build engineering credibility.
04.feat: monospace everywhere / $ prompt and path-style copy / pulsing green status dot / black, grey-green and acid yellow / ASCII ornaments

05.name: Glassmorphism + Retrofuturism
05.desc: Frosted cards floating on a glowing field with a CRT scanline on top: half premium, half nostalgia.
05.feat: backdrop-filter blur(16px) / translucent cards with a 1px highlight edge / scanline overlay / acid yellow against deep blue

06.name: Voxel Aesthetic
06.desc: A 16×16 block world turned into an interface, like opening a sandbox game inside a web page.
06.feat: image-rendering: pixelated / bevelled block borders / Press Start 2P pixel type / earth-tone limited palette / steps() frame animation

07.name: Neumorphism
07.desc: Elements share the background colour; two lights, one bright and one dark, press the shape out of the surface.
07.feat: same-colour ground #e0e5ec / dual soft shadows at 8px and 16px / inset pressed state / 20px radius / low-contrast grey-blue

08.name: Retro Win95
08.desc: A faithful replica of the 1995 desktop: windows, taskbar, start button, all of it.
08.feat: #008080 desktop / outset and inset 3D borders / #c0c0c0 panels / MS Sans Serif / dotted focus rectangle / pixel icons

09.name: Biophilic Design
09.desc: Brings sunlight, plants and handmade paper to the screen so the interface breathes.
09.feat: cream and sage green / radial-gradient dappled light / paper-textured cards / 16px radius / soft diffuse shadows

10.name: 3D & Hyperrealism
10.desc: Fakes real depth on a flat plane with perspective, layered shadows and material gradients.
10.feat: perspective 1000px / multi-axis hover transform / multi-layer rgba lighting / glass and metal gradients / smooth easing

11.name: Vibrant & Block-based
11.desc: Big colour blocks, clashing hues and heavy borders make the page a stack of saturated bricks.
11.feat: saturated red and yellow / 4–8px hard shadows / 3px black borders / zero radius / white ground for contrast

12.name: Dark Mode OLED
12.desc: A dark scheme tuned for pure-black panels: truly black, restrained in brightness.
12.feat: #000 ground / #0a0a0a cards with 1px #1a1a1a edge / white text, grey body / inverted buttons as anchors / saves power

13.name: Accessible & Ethical
13.desc: Readability and reachability as the primary aesthetic: plain before pretty.
13.feat: WCAG AA/AAA 4.5:1 / 2px borders / Atkinson Hyperlegible / 44×44 touch targets / always-visible focus ring

14.name: Claymorphism
14.desc: Elements look pressed from clay by a finger: soft, volumetric, not a hard edge anywhere.
14.feat: dual soft shadows plus inner shadow for volume / 24px radius / apricot to cocoa / no borders, light only

15.name: Aurora UI
15.desc: Flowing aurora fields on a dark ground behind frosted glass: the recent SaaS definition of premium.
15.feat: layered radial-gradient glows / blur(10px) frosted panels / emerald buttons / 1px luminous edges

16.name: Retro-Futurism
16.desc: The future as the 1980s imagined it: space purple, neon pink, buttons that glow.
16.feat: #1a0a2e space purple / neon pink glow / translucent purple cards / 80s sci-fi headings / warmer than cyberpunk

17.name: Flat Design
17.desc: No shadows, no gradients, no texture: just colour, shape and type.
17.feat: zero shadow and gradient / solid fills / brand blue #3490dc / 3–4px radius / renders fast

18.name: Liquid Glass
18.desc: Apple's 2025 language: the interface behaves like liquid glass that refracts what sits behind it.
18.feat: blur(20px) / very transparent cards / 16px radius as surface tension / edge light shifting with content / flowing highlights

19.name: Motion-Driven
19.desc: The page tells its story almost entirely through motion; scroll, hover and transition are the content.
19.feat: spring easing with overshoot / hover scale and rotate / scroll-driven animation / dark stage / respects prefers-reduced-motion

20.name: Micro-interactions
20.desc: No visual spectacle: just the right amount of feedback in every button and every state.
20.feat: press scale(0.95) / 200–300ms standard easing / progressive shadow / 2px hover lift / precise 1px edges

21.name: Inclusive Design
21.desc: Assumes visual, motor and cognitive differences, and builds one interface that works for everyone.
21.feat: high-contrast heavy borders / large touch targets / visible focus navigation / ≥16px type at 1.6 leading / never colour alone

22.name: Zero Interface
22.desc: The interface nearly disappears, leaving text and whitespace; interaction happens in conversation, not clicks.
22.feat: borderless transparent cards / no decorative hover / whitespace as hierarchy / a single input / built for AI and voice

23.name: Soft UI Evolution
23.desc: The enterprise middle ground between neumorphism and flat: a little soft, never at the cost of clarity.
23.feat: 1px border with layered soft shadow / light blue-grey #eef0f4 / blue-violet buttons #6382dc / 14px radius

24.name: Neubrutalism
24.desc: The optimistic brutalism: cream ground, red-yellow clashes, heavy black borders — the young-brand default.
24.feat: #fffaee cream ground / red and yellow clash / 3px black borders / 4px hard shadow / zero radius

25.name: Bento Box Grid
25.desc: Unequal rounded cards assembled like a Japanese bento, explaining every selling point in one screen.
25.feat: grid-column and row spans / Apple grey #f5f5f7 / 18px radius / division by whitespace, not borders / pill buttons

26.name: Y2K Aesthetic
26.desc: The millennium's idea of the future: icy blue to pink gradients, metallic sheen, controls so round they shine.
26.feat: ice blue to cherry pink gradient / frosted translucency / #ff69b4 with glow / 16px pill radius

27.name: Cyberpunk UI
27.desc: High-contrast neon on pure black with glitch: dystopian tech turned into a visual language.
27.feat: #0a0a0a with magenta and bright green neon / glowing borders and type / monospace / zero radius / glitch jitter

28.name: AI-Native UI
28.desc: The look AI products grew into: blue-violet gradients, luminous edges, conversation-first layout.
28.feat: #667eea to #764ba2 gradient / cards with violet edge glow / bright white ground / 12px radius / chat-first layout

29.name: Memphis Design
29.desc: Milan, 1981, against modernism: geometry, clashing colour and dots, deliberately out of tune.
29.feat: pink, cyan and yellow clash / alternating coloured hard shadows / dot and zigzag ornaments / displaced collage / 20px pills

30.name: Vaporwave
30.desc: 80s synth music and the residue of consumerism: pink neon with a little emptiness inside.
30.feat: pink and violet neon / Japanese and English mixed setting / marble, palm and Windows motifs / CRT scanlines and chroma shift / slow loops

31.name: Dimensional Layering
31.desc: Progressive shadows build a clear Z axis, giving every piece of information a distance.
31.feat: 1/2/4/8px shadow ladder / #f0f0f5 stage / large floating cards / 1px #eee hairlines

32.name: Exaggerated Minimalism
32.desc: Minimalism pushed until the type fills the screen and nothing else remains.
32.feat: 5rem at 900 weight, -0.05em tracking / pure white / no shadow, no ornament / 1px rules / no hover

33.name: Kinetic Typography
33.desc: Type becomes the protagonist; scale, rhythm and animation give it poster-level impact.
33.feat: 6rem+ headings / line-height 0.9 / extreme black and white / scroll and per-letter animation / film-poster feel

34.name: Parallax Storytelling
34.desc: Tells the story through differences in scroll speed, like a long scroll with depth.
34.feat: multi-layer parallax / translucent cards revealing the ground / vertical gradient chapters / long-scroll pacing / brand story pages

35.name: Swiss Modernism 2.0
35.desc: Swiss style taken to the extreme: strip everything, keep weight, leading and one hairline.
35.feat: 2px top rule / 4rem at 900 / 0.85 leading / no shadow, no radius / #fcfcfc white

36.name: HUD / Sci-Fi FUI
36.desc: The console language from sci-fi films: thin luminous lines, corner brackets, scrolling data.
36.feat: #001020 deep space blue / cyan glowing edges / monospace data type / rings and grid ticks / transparent buttons

37.name: Bento Grids 2.0
37.desc: A younger bento grid: warm grey ground, iPhone red accents, looser radii.
37.feat: #f2f2f7 warm grey / 20px radius / division by ground colour / grid spans / colour accents

38.name: Spatial UI / VisionOS
38.desc: Designed for headsets: panels of glass suspended in air, with thickness and lighting.
38.feat: blur(20px) / 22px radius / 1px luminous glass outline / deep-space gradient / light depth of field

39.name: E-Ink & Paper
39.desc: Turns the screen into paper: warm white, serif type, no shadow, built for long reading.
39.feat: #faf8f0 paper / Georgia serif / 1.8 leading / no shadow / 1px rules / no motion

40.name: Gen Z Chaos / Maximalism
40.desc: Carefully designed mess: saturation, displacement, stickers — a rejection of polish.
40.feat: bright yellow and orange-red / black and white mixed / displaced collage / heavy borders with coloured shadows / 30px pills

41.name: Biomimetic / Organic 2.0
41.desc: Borrows not the colours of nature but its growth logic and structure.
41.feat: green-grey vertical gradient / translucent cards like cell walls / organic irregular radii / growth and flow animation

42.name: Anti-Polish / Raw Aesthetic
42.desc: Deliberately undesigned: dashed frames, system fonts, zero radius — a wireframe shipped as is.
42.feat: dashed borders / monospace or system type / zero radius and shadow / no hover / plain text layout

43.name: Tactile Digital / Deformable UI
43.desc: Makes things on screen feel like paper, cloth or wood through thickness and deformation.
43.feat: 2px solid bottom shadow for thickness / active scale(0.98) / cotton and linen ground / dark walnut buttons

44.name: Nature Distilled
44.desc: No leaves, no mountains: nature reduced to proportion, colour temperature and restrained green.
44.feat: #f5f2eb parchment / forest green header #5a6a4a / 0.03 barely-there shadow / zones by temperature, not shadow

45.name: Interactive Cursor Design
45.desc: The pointer becomes the protagonist: crosshair, trail, magnetism — the cursor is the navigation.
45.feat: custom or crosshair cursor / trail and magnetism / faintly glowing cards / deep violet ground / default pointer hidden

46.name: Voice-First Multimodal
46.desc: Designed for speaking: one entry point, a ring of sound, everything else steps back.
46.feat: #0a0a1a very deep ground / soft blue-violet type / sound-wave rings / 16px radius / a single voice entry

47.name: 3D Product Preview
47.desc: Puts the product in a studio in front of a seamless wall, so the 3D model is the only content.
47.feat: light seamless studio ground / centred product with a large shadow / rotate and configurator / AR preview / monochrome system

48.name: Gradient Mesh / Aurora Evolved
48.desc: Aurora evolved: multiple coloured fields woven together into a breathing mesh.
48.feat: layered radial-gradient mesh / glass cards at 0.04 opacity / edges tinted by the nearest field / buttons that reflect colour

49.name: Chromatic Aberration / RGB Split
49.desc: Turns lens aberration, a defect, into a language: red, green and blue out of register.
49.feat: offset red, green and blue edges / text-shadow 2px red, -2px blue / monospace on black / hover jitter

50.name: Vintage Analog / Retro Film
50.desc: The feel of old photographs and old books: oxidised warm yellows, film grain, brown tones.
50.feat: #f5e8d0 warm paper / Georgia serif / film grain noise / #3a2a10 dark brown header / bronze buttons

text.一屏能扫 9 个，带分组筛选 · 每个 demo 都是 8 段完整页面: Nine per screen, grouped and filterable · every demo is a full 8-section page
text.前端设计风格大全 · 风格清单参考公开资料与视频配套仓库 · 标杆网站为风格参考: Frontend Design Styles · style list based on public sources; reference sites are examples, not the only ones
text.点左上角「⤓ 下载风格包」，得到一个 zip。里面就是这个风格的全部代码 + 说: Hit Download pack in the top bar. You get a zip with all the code and notes for this style.
text.你会看到这套风格的完整页面（落地页 + 105 个组件），双击就能看。: You'll see the full page in this style — landing page plus 105 components. Double-click to view.
text.点「📋 复制给 AI 的话」，粘给任意 AI，把最后一行换成你的需求即可。: Hit Copy prompt for AI, paste it into any AI, and swap the last line for your request.
text.zip 里还有 spec.md（规格卡）和 theme.css（现成样式表）: The zip also contains spec.md (spec card) and theme.css (ready-made stylesheet)
text.更快的构建、更少的维护、更好的体验。一套设计语言，覆盖从落地页到后台的全部界面。: Ship faster, maintain less, feel better. One design language from landing page to admin console.
text.组件即拿即用，半天就能搭出一个完整页面。: Drop-in components: a full page in half a day.
text.一套 token 管住颜色、间距和圆角，改一处全站生效。: One token set rules colour, spacing and radius. Change it once, everywhere follows.
text.默认适配键盘操作、屏幕阅读器和暗色模式。: Keyboard, screen readers and dark mode work by default.
text.切换 tab 相当于切换二级页面——同一个壳，不同的内容。: Switching tabs is like switching sub-pages: same shell, different content.
text.或点击选择 · PNG / JPG · ≤ 5MB: or click to choose · PNG / JPG · ≤ 5MB
text.弹窗支持 Esc 关闭、点遮罩关闭。: Esc closes it, and so does clicking the overlay.
